name: Placenta Pathology Foundation Models Benchmark
description: An evaluation suite benchmarking foundation models on non-neoplastic placental pathology tasks (e.g., classification/segmentation) using pathology images.
general_score_metric: Dice (F1) for segmentation (primary), accuracy for classification
reputation: A niche, specialist benchmark used primarily by researchers working on placental histopathology and medical imaging; limited mainstream adoption.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; small, specialized dataset with expert annotations; inter-rater label variability and domain shift risk; potential for data leakage if pretraining used pathology corpora.
